site.name: Guruprasad Karanam
site.intro: A collection of working demos — integration processes, real-time APIs and the web front ends that use them. Each project lives in its own folder under /projects.

projects.title: Integrasi Connect - Embedded AI Data Hub (Boomi OEM demo)
projects.summary: A white-label, multi-tenant portal where each customer connects SAP, Salesforce, file drops and Malaysian government open data, maps fields onto an AI knowledge document, and runs one configuration-driven Boomi pipeline that masks personal data and chunks content for RAG. Includes a live Boomi run view, AI knowledge search with citations and a composable API catalogue.
highlights: One Boomi pipeline for every tenant: Route by source system, tenant mapping, PII masking (MyKad, phone, e-mail), chunking
Live sources: SAP API Business Hub sandbox and data.gov.my; Salesforce simulated; CSV parsed in Boomi
Onboard a new customer, map and run it in minutes - no code, no redeploy

projects.title: Copperleaf Provisions - AP Invoice 3-Way Match
projects.summary: Upload a vendor invoice PDF and watch a Boomi process match it against the purchase order and goods receipts: quantity, unit price and line value with tolerances, then approval for payment or routing to the AP exception queue. Includes a matching dashboard and seven sample invoices.
highlights: PDF text extraction in a Node gateway; matching runs in a Boomi API Service
Mock ERP and WMS subprocesses (split, filter, combine) ready to swap for real connectors
Live step view replayed from the Boomi execution's own timestamps

projects.title: Copperleaf Provisions — Operations Portal
projects.summary: A sales and master-data portal for a fictitious fine-food wholesaler. Every screen is backed by Boomi real-time APIs that call the Northwind OData V2 service: a KPI dashboard with charts, orders with printable invoices, product order insight, customers, suppliers and employees.
highlights: 8 REST routes on one Boomi API Service, each a listener + testable subprocess
Dashboard process fans out to 11 OData queries with a Branch step
Runs live: GitHub Pages front end calls a Railway-hosted gateway that holds the Boomi credentials
